chosen.premise: A sweet smell from Ivysaur’s back is evidence that its huge flower is about to bloom.
chosen.hook: If Ivysaur starts smelling sweet, its flower is nearly here.
chosen.visualIdea: A scent trail emerges from the swelling bud, then transforms into a countdown ending on a giant flower silhouette.
chosen.note: The unusual smell-as-bloom-warning premise is repeated across multiple entries, creating a clear mystery and payoff.

candidates.premise: A sweet smell from Ivysaur’s back is evidence that its huge flower is about to bloom.
candidates.hook: If Ivysaur starts smelling sweet, its flower is nearly here.
candidates.visualIdea: A scent trail emerges from the swelling bud, then transforms into a countdown ending on a giant flower silhouette.
candidates.note: The unusual smell-as-bloom-warning premise is repeated across multiple entries, creating a clear mystery and payoff.

candidates.premise: Ivysaur’s bulb can grow so large that it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.
candidates.hook: Ivysaur’s own back bulb may make standing upright impossible.
candidates.visualIdea: Ivysaur tries to rise on its hind legs as an oversized bulb scales upward and gently pushes it back down.
candidates.note: A highly specific physical consequence of Ivysaur’s bulb, directly stated in the Red Pokédex entry and easy to animate.

candidates.premise: Ivysaur spending more time lying in sunlight is a sign its bud will soon become a large flower.
candidates.hook: Ivysaur sunbathing isn’t laziness—it’s a bloom warning.
candidates.visualIdea: A sunbathing meter fills while the bud visibly enlarges, ending in a flash-cut to the coming flower.
candidates.note: Strongly supported and visually clear, though the sunlight-growth idea is somewhat familiar for a Grass-type Pokémon.

candidates.premise: Ivysaur’s legs and trunk grow thick and strong specifically to support the weight of the bulb on its back.
candidates.hook: Ivysaur’s sturdy body is basically built to carry one giant bulb.
candidates.visualIdea: An X-ray-style load diagram shows the back bulb’s weight pressing down as Ivysaur’s legs and trunk thicken underneath.
candidates.note: The body-support adaptation is well supported, but the load diagram and implication that the bulb’s weight is measurable go beyond the cited facts.

candidates.premise: Ivysaur exists only between evolving from Bulbasaur at level 16 and evolving into Venusaur at level 32.
candidates.hook: Ivysaur gets just 16 levels between two major transformations.
candidates.visualIdea: A level bar races from 16 to 32: Bulbasaur becomes Ivysaur at one end, then Ivysaur becomes Venusaur at the other.
candidates.note: A clean numerical structure, but level-based evolution is familiar and the cited evolution methods come from trusted secondary data rather than the Pokédex entries.

candidates.premise: Ivysaur’s back growth is fueled by energy, nutrients, and sunlight before becoming a large flower.
candidates.hook: Ivysaur’s bulb has three different fuel sources before it blooms.
candidates.visualIdea: Energy, nutrient, and sunlight icons flow into the bulb like a three-input machine, triggering a flower-bloom reveal.
candidates.note: Visually attractive, but the entries describe related growth mechanisms rather than definitively establishing three separate fuel inputs.

rounds.request: None—the chosen angle is strong enough. Stronger alternatives would need an equally unusual Ivysaur-specific rule, repeated official support, and a more concrete visual payoff than the bloom warning.
